why: The interim U.S. export rule changes the conditions under which overseas data centers can provide advanced American computing to users in restricted countries. BIS supplies an official source, and AP, Axios and TechCrunch covered the announcement on November 16. It gives readers a concrete policy change affecting chip suppliers and cloud operators, distinct from the recent stories on AI safety litigation.

set_aside.why: The California suit has broad coverage and an official complaint, but follows another AI safety lawsuit already covered; its allegations require careful response reporting.
The MIT design copilot offers a useful research advance, though its immediate reach and independent coverage are narrower than the export rule.
